laws.rule: Similar to the UK, there are harsh penalties in Anguilla if you’re caught with illegal drugs.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs penalties

laws.rule: Topless and nude sunbathing is illegal in Anguilla.
laws.heading: Public nudity

laws.rule: Same-sex sexual activity is legal in Anguilla but there’s no provision for marriage or civil partnership. Hotels and resorts are generally welcoming of same-sex couples. Local attitudes can be conservative and same-sex couples showing affection in public may receive unwanted attention. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
laws.heading: LGBT+ travellers

laws.rule: See water safety on holiday from the Royal Life Saving Society.
laws.heading: Swimming safety

laws.rule: Diving schools may have limited resources and do not always observe safety and maintenance standards. Always: ask to see a dive operator’s credentials check the conditions on your insurance policy – some policies require dive instructors to have certain qualifications make sure safety equipment looks to be in good condition make sure oxygen is available on the boat There are no facilities for treating decompression sickness in Anguilla. Get advice on the safe depth for your dive. If you have not had any previous diving experience, check what to do if something goes wrong, including how to call for help while at sea.
laws.heading: Scuba diving
